verdict.rationale: The firm says it serves "foreign nationals and their employers" and works with "company contacts and HR teams." It lists employer-sponsored categories such as H-1B and L-1 intracompany transfers among its services, so employer-side sponsorship is clearly part of the practice. However, the evidence never documents the specific employer services the story names. missing for 10: explicit H-1B transfer and cap-registration services, LCA preparation and compliance support, a description of employer paperwork and public access file handling, independent corroboration of employer-side work.
